messages:
liam: Heads-up: enterprise prospect requires BYOK import into our HSM proxy and wants explicit RBAC change windows, signed forensic exports, and a short IR SLA. Looping @yasmin @roberto for ops/legal context.

yasmin: Quick clarifying q: do they want persistent import operators or strictly JIT? My preference is JIT-only for import ops (STS session, MFA + hardware token), persistent only for non-import admin tasks.

roberto: Agreed. JIT flow: ticket created -> 2 approvers -> STS token with tags (ticket_id, approver_ids, expires). Import API must refuse requests missing ticket_id. TTL default 2h.

mika: Audit requirements: signed daily forensic tarball (gz) containing JSONL events + HSM attestation metadata (serial, fw_sha256). Sign with ed25519 and include RFC3161 TSA token for the tarball root. Mirror to Object Lock bucket (governance) and offer cross-account copy to customer if requested.

liam: Legal also asks: what minimal IR timeline can we promise for suspected operator compromise? Bullet it out pls.

yasmin: Short IR sketch: 1) auto-revoke import entitlements (<=2m), 2) create signed forensic tarball snapshot (<=6h), 3) if vendor supports quarantine request, instruct vendor; otherwise mark keys suspect and schedule rewrap, 4) customer notification within 4h with follow-up RCA by 72h.

roberto: Vulnerability triage addendum: if HSM vendor CVE affects the model/firmware, block imports for that model until patch/mitigation. Implement pre-import allowlist: proxy requires headers `X-HSM-SERIAL` and `X-HSM-FW-SHA256`; verify against onboarding allowlist. If mismatch -> deny and open P0.

alert-bot: advisory: vendor-hsm-cve-2026-7777 detected for model "Nebula-4". See infra advisory: https://infra/hsm/advisories/7777

mika: For tamper evidence: include per-event Merkle proofs in the tarball and publish daily merkle root to our read-only transparency ledger (so customer can verify inclusion). Also retain signer cert chain + TSA response in the bundle.

legal-bot: question: customer requested 3yr immutability and attestation of no-escrow. We need contract language for escrowless and for proof-of-retention.

liam: Draft language suggestion: "Provider will store signed forensic exports in immutable storage for the agreed retention term. For escrowless setups Provider makes no key-recovery guarantees and will provide signed attestations and exported evidence on request." Legal please iterate.

roberto: Implementation notes: 1) Proxy change: enforce ticket_id header and STS tag check. 2) Add pre-import allowlist lookup. 3) Hook CloudTrail + syslog -> signed export pipeline. 4) Add alert rules: multiple ImportKeyMaterial events from distinct operators within 30m -> auto-revoke + P0.

yasmin: Dual-operator imports: our proxy only supports single-op today. Options: a) customer supplies threshold HSM, b) manual dual-op (video witness + signed attestations) as contractual mitigation. Document both in onboarding checklist.

mika: Cost/retention: Object Lock + Glacier Deep Archive acceptable. We'll produce cost appendix. Also include a checksum manifest (sha256) per tarball for provable integrity.

liam: Nice. Action items: Yasmin -> JIT RBAC + ticket flow doc; Roberto -> pre-import allowlist + auto-block runbook; Mika -> signed-tarball spec (merkle + RFC3161 + storage paths) + cost estimate; Legal -> draft escrowless clause and retention wording. I'll open onboarding ticket and attach these docs. Shareable with Sales?

yasmin: Shareable.

roberto: SGTM.

mika: OK.

liam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
